title: Mathematical Construction of the Negative-Phase Coulomb Category
exact_target: Construct the predicted negative-phase Coulomb category and prove its equivalence with the derived category of projective space.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005246 (OWR-11695854-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
